headword: {最先端技術|さいせんたんぎじゅつ}
reading: さいせんたんぎじゅつ

definitions.gloss: cutting-edge technology; state-of-the-art technology; advanced technology
definitions.explanation: The most advanced and newest technology available. Commonly used in discussions about innovation, research, and industry.

examples.japanese: {最先端技術|さいせんたんぎじゅつ}を{使|つか}った{製品|せいひん}が{発売|はつばい}された。
examples.english: A product using cutting-edge technology was released.

examples.japanese: この{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}では{最先端技術|さいせんたんぎじゅつ}の{開発|かいはつ}が{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: This research institute is developing cutting-edge technologies.

examples.japanese: {最先端技術|さいせんたんぎじゅつ}を{医療|いりょう}に{応用|おうよう}することで、これまで{治|なお}せなかった{病気|びょうき}も{治療|ちりょう}できるようになった。
examples.english: By applying cutting-edge technology to medicine, it has become possible to treat diseases that couldn't be cured before.

notes:
USAGE:
{最先端|さいせんたん} (cutting edge, forefront) is a productive modifier: {最先端|さいせんたん}の{医療|いりょう} (cutting-edge medicine), {最先端|さいせんたん}の{研究|けんきゅう} (cutting-edge research). The compound {最先端技術|さいせんたんぎじゅつ} specifically refers to technology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最先端技術|さいせんたんぎじゅつ}を{活用|かつよう}する (to utilize cutting-edge technology)
- {最先端技術|さいせんたんぎじゅつ}の{開発|かいはつ} (development of advanced technology)
- {最先端技術|さいせんたんぎじゅつ}を{導入|どうにゅう}する (to introduce cutting-edge technology)
